about.title: Integrity | Transparency | Innovation | Execution
about.intro: ISPAY was founded by early digital asset pioneers and technology experts. Its core leadership team has extensive experience from globally leading technology companies such as Google, Microsoft, and Facebook.
about.p1: ISPAY has deep engineering capabilities and proven expertise in building and scaling internet products. As a foundational blockchain infrastructure provider, ISPAY is committed to delivering secure, compliant, and high-quality digital asset services for users worldwide.
about.p2: Upholding the principle of responsible innovation, ISPAY insists on integrity, fairness, and proactive customer engagement, while pursuing open collaboration with partners and projects to create real value for the global digital economy.

video.eyebrow: DESIGNING THE FUTURE OF SECURE GLOBAL FINANCE
video.title: A Structural Shift in Global Finance
video.p1: Global financial systems are undergoing a structural transformation driven by digital settlement, real-time payments, enhanced transparency, and increased regulatory oversight.
video.p2: Legacy correspondent banking models are increasingly constrained by cost, latency, and fragmentation. Governments and financial institutions worldwide are transitioning toward infrastructure-based digital finance.
video.p3: ISPAY is designed within this global transition.

footer.tagline: ISPAY was established by early digital asset pioneers and technology specialists.

about.goalsIntro: The main objectives of the ISPAY program are to:
about.g1: Establish secure domestic and cross-border payment infrastructure;
about.g2: Enable regulated digital banking and card-based financial services;
about.g3: Provide transparent, auditable blockchain-based settlement mechanisms;
about.g4: Support interoperable financial systems compatible with existing banks;
about.g5: Expand financial inclusion at the population and enterprise levels;
about.g6: Preserve monetary sovereignty and regulatory control.
about.principlesIntro: The ISPAY program adheres to the following principles:
about.p1: Integrity: transparent and auditable financial operations;
about.p2: Compliance: compliance with national laws and regulations;
about.p3: Security: institutional-grade encryption and operational safeguards;
about.p4: Scalability: capacity to support national and regional development;
about.p5: Sovereignty: full national autonomy over deployment and oversight.
about.visionText: To build a borderless financial future where decentralized technology meets real-world utility.
about.missionText: To build compliant Web3 infrastructure connecting blockchains, assets, and people, enabling global participation in a unified digital economy.
about.remittanceSubtitle: Technical Brief: A hybrid decentralized infrastructure for regulated, high-volume cross-border payments
about.overviewText: The ISPAY Global Remittance system is built as a hybrid decentralized system that combines the interoperability of public blockchains with permissioned execution and governance layers, enabling high-volume, low-latency cross-border payments while maintaining regulatory control and operational reliability.
about.flawsIntro: The architecture avoids two common flaws of remittance systems:
about.flaw1: Fully centralized systems lack transparency and resilience;
about.flaw2: Fully permissionless systems lack compliance, governance, and deterministic control.

leadership.heading: Meet the leaders behind our success
leadership.name: Marcel Velez (ISPAY President)
leadership.p1: BRC-20, the world's fourth-largest protocol, is not just a technical milestone — it is the cornerstone of a global financial revolution. ISPay is building the world's first protocol-level interoperable ecosystem, enabling digital assets to move securely, transparently, and at scale across blockchains. Critical infrastructure designed for real-world use, with institutional-grade reliability, laying the foundation. Today, we globally
leadership.p2: serve 7 million users, on our way to 20 million, growing under my leadership. Under my leadership, ISPay reaches every corner of the world, aiming to empower 20 million users in the near future and build a financial ecosystem that transcends borders, cultures, and languages. From Asia to the Americas, from Europe to Africa, we are making decentralized, empowering financial tools universal, turning user participation into real value.
leadership.p3: At ISPay, our leadership team are pioneers. We launched the world's first ISPay token interchange platform, enabling truly decentralized multi-chain trading; we also launched the first ISPay on-chain mall, perfectly blending commerce and finance, with every transaction delivering substantial cashback, rewards, and meaningful financial participation.
leadership.p4: From ISPay Social (with communities and cities reaching over a million participants) to ISPay Wallet, Exchange, Games, and Mining, every product embodies our mission: empowering individuals, supporting businesses, and advancing global behavioral finance.
leadership.p5: This is not just innovation — it is a movement reshaping how the world interacts with value, governance, and wealth. ISPay turns everyday activities, social interactions, commerce, gaming, and financial participation into real on-chain influence. We do not wait for the future — we are the rails of the future, moving forward together, unstoppable.
leadership.p6: Our ISPay token is decentralized and compliant, powering this ecosystem and turning social, financial, and commercial activity into tangible impact.
